definitions: Used to indicate that something one has just said should not be taken seriously.
A phrase used to retract a statement, often a playful or teasing one, by indicating it was not meant to be true.
examples: I'm going to quit my job and become a professional napper. Just kidding!
You owe me a million dollars. Just kidding, but you do owe me a coffee.
I hate your new haircut. Just kidding, it looks great!
